// diagnostic

E0756

A function whose row names a library effect reaches a kernel effect the `#FX(…)` above that effect doesn't list

What

A function whose row names a library effect reaches a kernel effect the `#FX(…)` above that effect doesn't list

Why

A library effect stands for the kernel effects listed above it, so a row that names it may do those and nothing else

Fix

Add the kernel effect to the `#FX(…)` above the library effect, add it to the function's row, or stop using it

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0756: tests/ui/effects/library_effect_reach_outside_is_e0756.stderr.

Error [jet.LibraryEffectReachOutside]: `load` uses `FS.Read`, which `Query` doesn't list
  --> tests/ui/effects/library_effect_reach_outside_is_e0756.jet:8:26
    |
  8 | load: fn(path: String) -[Query]> String {
    |                          ^^^^^
 Why: A row that names the library effect `Query` may do what the `#FX(…)` above it lists, here `Net`; `FS.Read` is not among them
 Fix: Add `FS.Read` to the `#FX(…)` above `Query`, add it to `load`'s row, or stop using it in `load`
 Denial: invocation
 Call chain: load
